messages:
maria_p: Heads-up — product wants a new dashboard that ties user-visible errors + latency to traces and request IDs. We need coordination: runtime needs to guarantee propagation of a stable request id or span id and infra needs to expose counters.

sam_r: Are we talking about a new header, or relying on existing traceparent/x-b3-*?

maria_p: Prefer a stable request id for dashboard rollups (e.g., to dedupe retries and correlate logs) — traceparent is great for spans but we want a single request identifier at the API edge.

ali_s: Runtime note: we already attach x-rw-reqid at edge for most requests but we sometimes strip it for internal routing to reduce header overhead. If dashboards depend on it we need a hard contract.

katie_p: product: We need (1) per-route sampled traces, (2) aggregated counts by request_id presence, and (3) error traces linked to user session ids. The dashboard will show rate of missing reqids and how that correlates with latency.

sam_r: Implementation options I see: 
- always emit x-rw-reqid from edge and keep it through routing (cheap)
- fallback: if missing, generate at first service boundary and mark origin
- rely on traceparent + extract trace id for rollups (but that mixes sampling semantics)

jorge_i: Ops: Prometheus metrics we can expose easily: request_id_present_total{route="..."}, request_id_missing_total, reqid_origin{edge|service}. Also histograms for latency labelled by request_id_present.

nina_ops: Also need to be careful with sampling — if only sampled traces are sent to Jaeger/Tempo, dashboards that rely on trace spans will be biased. We'll need a small always-on sample for dashboard linking or a sidechannel.

maria_p: Good point. Proposal: have three sampling tiers: 
- metrics-only: increment counters for every request (no spans)
- trace-sample (1 in N): full span export for perf debugging
- dashboard-trace (explicit): for requests that hit alerts or are flagged by heuristics we always export trace.

ali_s: That maps to runtime changes: add header X-RW-ReqID (if missing generate at edge), add X-RW-Sampling-Hint: "metrics|trace|dashboard". Runtime will pass both headers through. We'll need a lightweight path that increments metrics in-process without blocking on exporter.

sam_r: For tracing backends, we can use trace id when trace is exported. But for dashboard correlation we should prefer X-RW-ReqID; it's stable across retries. Also record span_id in logs when we exported a trace.

katie_p: UX ask: in the console dashboard, show a badge when reqid is missing and allow clicking to open sampled trace if available. Also show sampling hint and origin.

devex_bot: Deploy-checklist: 
1) add header contract doc in /docs/runtime/reqid-propagation.md
2) runtime unit tests for header passthrough + generation
3) metrics endpoint patch for reqid_present_total
4) backend pipeline to join logs/metrics/traces by reqid

maria_p: Can we get owners? Sam -> runtime header changes. Jorge -> metrics exposure. Nina -> sampling policy and exporter config. Ali -> ensure internal routing keeps headers by default. Devex -> doc + SDK snippet. Katie -> console UX prototype.

sam_r: I'll open a PR with the header passthrough and a toggle flag (default on) so we can enable in canary. Will add a small in-process counter increment to avoid exporter latency.

jorge_i: I'll add the Prometheus counters and a per-route label. Keep cardinality low: route and sampling_hint only.

nina_ops: I'll draft a sampling config: default trace-sample 1:1000, dashboard-trace heuristics (5xx, high latency, quota burn spikes) -> force export. Also add a 1:100000 "always include trace id in metrics" sampler for long-term signal.

ali_s: Quick question: do we allow services to rewrite X-RW-ReqID? We should forbid unless explicitly flagged (X-RW-ReqID-Origin=service-name). Otherwise ownership gets messy.

maria_p: Agreed — deny rewrite by default. If a service needs to issue a new reqid, it must set origin and explain in the audit log.

katie_p: Timing: product wants a minimal dashboard for the QBR in 3 weeks. We need the metrics + header guarantee in 2 weeks to instrument. Is that feasible?

sam_r: With the toggle and canary I can ship header passthrough in 7 days. Exposing counters is another 3-5 days.

jorge_i: Metrics patch should be quick — I'll prioritize.

nina_ops: Exporter config and sampling rules I'll have a first draft in 4 days, tests in 10.

maria_p: Great. Action items recap (copy/paste):
- sam_r: PR for X-RW-ReqID passthrough + generator at edge, default on toggle (due +7d)
- ali_s: Ensure internal router retains header and denies rewrites (due +7d)
- jorge_i: Add Prom counters request_id_present_total / missing_total + route/sampling_hint labels (due +5d)
- nina_ops: Sampling policy + exporter config (draft +4d, tests +10d)
- devex_bot: Create docs + example SDK snippet for reading X-RW-ReqID and linking traces (due +6d)
- katie_p: Console mockups for reqid-badges and trace drilldown (due +10d)

maria_p: If anyone hits blockers ping me and we'll triage in the platform sync.

ali_s: One more note: we should include a small retention of un-sampled trace metadata (trace_id -> reqid mapping) for a short window (24h) to enrich dashboards without full spans. Ops can store in a lightweight KV.

nina_ops: agreed — I'll include TTL mapping in the exporter plan.

maria_p: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in 48h with PR links. :thumbsup:
